features.title: Task decomposition planner
features.note: Validated DAG (cycle/dep/id/size checks), deterministic keyword decomposition. Not yet fed by PlanService.

features.title: Agent-to-agent delegation
features.note: Non-escalating tool scope, conserved budget, depth/fan-out caps, cycle refusal.

features.title: Shared task board
features.note: Team-scoped cards, transition table, version CAS, no foreign-card oracle. In-memory; no table/route.

features.title: Agent team or swarm mode
features.note: Layers run concurrently, failures skip dependents and escalate. Executor is injected; no live-model swarm run.

features.title: Independent context windows per subagent
features.note: Windows seeded only from contract-named keys; token budget eviction. Token count is a len/4 estimate.

needs_integration: API routes, persistence tables (A1 migrations) and wiring to PlanService/S5 are not done; package is standalone and in-memory

VR024: Killable process groups (no zombie spend), fair scheduler, idempotent retries.
